name: Godfather
ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
setup: -1 or +1 Outsider (Storyteller's choice): swap one Townsfolk for an Outsider or one Outsider for a Townsfolk before tokens go in the bag.
wakes: First night, to learn the Outsiders in play. Other nights only if an Outsider died during the day.
interaction: First night: shown every Outsider token in play (possibly none). Other nights after an Outsider died today: chooses a player, who dies.
drunk_or_poisoned: First night: may be shown false Outsider tokens. On a kill night: the chosen player does not die. The setup modifier already applied is unaffected.

rulings.text: Only Outsider deaths by day count; an Outsider dying at night does not enable a kill.
Multiple Outsiders dying in one day still gives only one kill that night.
An Outsider who survives execution (e.g. Devil's Advocate protection) did not die, so the Godfather does not act.
The Godfather may choose any player, including themselves.

test_scenarios.name: learns outsiders
test_scenarios.setup: Ann Godfather, Bob Imp, Cid Lunatic, Dot Moonchild, Eli Chef, Fay Empath, Gus Monk, Hal Soldier
test_scenarios.expected: Ann is shown Lunatic and Moonchild.

test_scenarios.name: kill after outsider executed
test_scenarios.setup: Ann Godfather, Bob Imp, Cid Lunatic, Dot Pacifist, Eli Chef, Fay Empath, Gus Monk, Hal Soldier
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Cid executed. Night 2: Ann chooses Eli.
test_scenarios.expected: Eli dies (Died today on Cid, Dead on Eli).

test_scenarios.name: outsider dies at night
test_scenarios.setup: Ann Godfather, Bob Imp, Cid Saint, Dot Recluse, Eli Chef, Fay Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Imp kills Cid. Day 2: no execution. Night 3.
test_scenarios.expected: Ann does not wake; no Godfather kill.

test_scenarios.name: two outsiders die same day
test_scenarios.setup: Ann Godfather, Bob Imp, Cid Tinker, Dot Lunatic, Eli Chef, Fay Empath, Gus Monk, Hal Soldier
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Cid dies by Tinker ability, Dot executed. Night 2: Ann chooses Fay.
test_scenarios.expected: Only Fay dies from the Godfather; one kill only.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned godfather
test_scenarios.setup: Ann Godfather, Bob No Dashii (neighbouring Ann), Cid Lunatic, Dot Mutant, Eli Chef, Fay Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Cid executed. Night 2: Ann (poisoned by No Dashii) chooses Eli.
test_scenarios.expected: Eli does not die from the Godfather.
